title: High molecular weight DNA extraction after Bolger et al.
author: Bolger et al.
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.hhqb35w
materials: Nanodrop results: a Qubit to Nanodrop ratio: 0.7

steps.title: Prepare buffers and chill
steps.instruction: Prepare extraction buffer, nuclear buffer, and TE buffer and keep all solutions at 4 °C before starting.

steps.title: Harvest leaves in cold TE
steps.instruction: Harvest 50 g of young leaves and place them into 1 L ice‑cold TE buffer (pH 7).

steps.title: Blend leaves with lysis buffer
steps.instruction: Transfer the leaves to a pre‑chilled Waring blender, add 600 mL lysis buffer, and keep the work area at 4 °C.

steps.title: Homogenize tissue
steps.instruction: Homogenise in 15 s bursts for a total of 1 min 15 s (adjust time if needed for the plant material).

steps.title: Filter homogenate through Miracloth
steps.instruction: Pass the homogenate through 4 layers of Miracloth, then gravity‑filter through an additional 8 layers of Miracloth.

steps.title: Add Triton X‑100 to 0.5%
steps.instruction: Add 10 % (v/v) Triton X‑100 stock to the filtrate to reach a final concentration of 0.5 % (v/v).

steps.title: Incubate on ice with rocking
steps.instruction: Incubate the mixture on an ice bath with gentle rocking for 30 min.

steps.title: Adjust volume with nuclear buffer to 10 mL
steps.instruction: Add sufficient nuclear buffer to bring the total volume up to 10 mL.

steps.title: First centrifugation (600 g, 4 °C, 20 min)
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the suspension at 600 g, 4 °C for 20 min.

steps.title: Wash pellet – resuspend and incubate 60 °C
steps.instruction: Gently resuspend the pellet with a sterilised painter’s brush soaked in freshly made pre‑chilled nuclear buffer, add nuclear buffer to bring the volume to 5 mL, incubate at 60 °C for 10 min, then let cool to room temperature.

steps.title: Repeat wash two additional times
steps.instruction: Repeat the wash (add nuclear buffer to 10 mL, centrifuge 600 g, 4 °C, 20 min, resuspend as above, incubate 60 °C 10 min, cool) twice more until the pellet is grey‑white and no green remains.

steps.title: Add sodium perchlorate to 1 M
steps.instruction: Add 5 M sodium perchlorate to the suspension to reach a final concentration of 1 M.

steps.title: Phenol‑chloroform extraction (first)
steps.instruction: Add an equal volume of phenol : chloroform : isoamyl alcohol (25 : 24 : 1) to the tube.

steps.title: Mix on rotor 10 min
steps.instruction: Mix the tube on a rotor for 10 min.

steps.title: Centrifuge extraction mix
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 3000 g, 22 °C for 10 min.

steps.title: Collect aqueous phase
steps.instruction: Transfer the upper aqueous phase to a new tube and discard the lower organic phase.

steps.title: Repeat phenol‑chloroform extraction once
steps.instruction: Repeat steps of adding equal volume phenol : chloroform : isoamyl alcohol, mixing 10 min, centrifuging, and collecting the upper phase.

steps.title: Two chloroform‑isoamyl extractions
steps.instruction: Repeat the extraction two more times using only chloroform : isoamyl alcohol (24 : 1) (no phenol).

steps.title: Precipitate DNA with ethanol
steps.instruction: Add 2 × volume of ice‑cold ethanol to the aqueous phase and gently invert several times to precipitate DNA.

steps.title: Transfer pellet and evaporate ethanol
steps.instruction: Transfer the DNA pellet to a 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube and allow the ethanol to evaporate for approximately 5 min (avoid over‑drying).

steps.title: Quantify DNA (Qubit & Nanodrop)
steps.instruction: Measure dsDNA concentration with a Qubit fluorometer and absorbance with a Nanodrop; dilute 1:10 if the concentration is too high.

steps.title: Run 0.8 % agarose gel
steps.instruction: Run a 0.8 % TBE agarose gel loading 200 ng dsDNA together with a λ‑HindIII ladder as a control.

steps.title: Run pulse‑field gel electrophoresis
steps.instruction: If available, run a pulse‑field gel electrophoresis (PFGE) with 200 ng dsDNA and a MidRange PFG Marker II ladder as a control.

steps.title: Test shearing by vortexing and pipetting
steps.instruction: Prepare aliquots of the extracted DNA and subject them to the following treatments before PFGE: original sample (G1), vortex 10 s (v10), vortex 20 s (v20), vortex 30 s (v30), vortex 60 s (v60), pipette up/down 5 times (p5), 10 times (p10), 30 times (p30), and 60 times (p60). Load each treated sample onto the PFGE gel to assess DNA shearing.
